limitations: The article PDF was consulted from an accessible institutional-hosted copy because the local JAR source package contains no main-paper PDF.
The author-prepared workbook and data-description sheet do not provide runnable author syntax or exact SPSS import/dialog settings. SPSS 22 was not available for a software-to-software check.

Six participants' supplied link and nonlink fixation ratios both sum to zero; one participant's supplied ratios sum to approximately 1.558. The provided columns are analyzed as supplied, without recomputation or exclusion.
Online Appendix Table A1 prints below-median chi-square 2.10, while its reported 19/11 counts imply 2.1333; the recomputed p-value remains above .10.

Table 6's printed measure-by-presentation mean square (0.12) is internally inconsistent with its printed F (0.21) and within-subject residual mean square (0.05). Reproduced comparison is limited to F, degrees of freedom, p-values, and sample size, not every mean-square cell.
The Stata log timestamps show 24 Nov 2024 while the system date during execution was 20 Nov 2026; native log content and process completion are retained unchanged.
